name: James Rhodes

bio.statement: OPB reports the Clackamas County Board of Commissioners appointed Rhodes interim sheriff in July 2026 after Sheriff Angela Brandenburg's resignation.
bio.excerpt: The board of county commissioners appointed him to serve as interim sheriff in July

bio.statement: Rhodes's pamphlet statement lists Clackamas County Sheriff's Office service from 1997 to 2021, including undersheriff and captain.
bio.excerpt: Clackamas County Sheriff’s Office, 1997- 2021: Undersheriff; Captain, Patrol, Investigations, Civil Division;

bio.statement: Rhodes's pamphlet statement lists service as Wilsonville chief of police and as a child abuse and homicide detective.
bio.excerpt: Wilsonville Chief of Police; Detective, Child Abuse and Homicide; Sergeant; Search and Rescue Coordinator.

bio.statement: Rhodes's pamphlet statement lists a B.S. in law enforcement from Western Oregon and an A.A. from Clackamas Community College.
bio.excerpt: B.S., Law Enforcement, Western Oregon; A.A., Criminal Justice, Clackamas Community College;

positions.statement: In his voters' pamphlet statement, Rhodes lists protecting patrol, jail and investigative services and improving response and property-crime follow-up.
positions.excerpt: Protect patrol, jail, and investigative services; Improve response and property-crime follow-up;

positions.statement: Rhodes's pamphlet statement lists restoring traffic and DUII enforcement.
Rhodes's pamphlet statement lists targeting fentanyl traffickers and serious criminals.
positions.excerpt: Target fentanyl traffickers and serious criminals;

positions.statement: Rhodes's pamphlet statement says he is committed to spending taxpayer dollars wisely while protecting the front line.
positions.excerpt: As Sheriff, I’m committed to spending taxpayer dollars wisely while protecting the front line.

positions.statement: In an October 2026 OPB article, Rhodes says he intends to own the sheriff's levy and aims to reduce it to a reasonable rate.
positions.excerpt: "I intend to own the levy," Rhodes said. ... He said he aims to reduce the levy to a reasonable rate

collection_log.query_or_url: https://electsheriffrhodes.com (domain printed in pamphlet; not fetched, pamphlet content used)

collection_notes: Incumbent as appointed (interim) sheriff: county elections page lists 'Sheriff James Rhodes' among elected officials; OPB 2026-07-28 says the board appointed him after Sheriff Angela Brandenburg resigned, to serve until a new sheriff is sworn in after the November election. OPB also reports the deputies' union endorsed Rhodes (endorsement, not used). Items p5 excerpt joins two adjacent OPB sentences with an ellipsis.
